MANAGE_MARKET.title: Manage Market
MANAGE_MARKET.description: Can manage market categories, products, comparisons, gifts, discounts, coupons, creator codes, orders and settings.

MANAGE_MARKET_CATALOG.title: Manage Market Catalog
MANAGE_MARKET_CATALOG.description: Can manage market categories, products, variants, bundles, comparisons, goals and stock.

VIEW_MARKET_ORDERS.title: View Market Orders
VIEW_MARKET_ORDERS.description: Can view market orders, deliveries, shipments, subscriptions and payment events, and export orders. Cannot change anything.

MANAGE_MARKET_ORDERS.title: Manage Market Fulfilment
MANAGE_MARKET_ORDERS.description: Can re-run or cancel deliveries, revoke purchases, manage shipments, resend order mails, edit order notes and manage the block list.

MANAGE_MARKET_PAYMENTS.title: Manage Market Payments
MANAGE_MARKET_PAYMENTS.description: Can do everything that moves money: refunds, marking orders paid, reviews, disputes, manual orders, credits, creator payouts and subscription charges.

MANAGE_MARKET_DISCOUNTS.title: Manage Market Discounts
MANAGE_MARKET_DISCOUNTS.description: Can manage discounts, coupons, creator codes, gifts and redemption lists.

MANAGE_MARKET_SETTINGS.title: Manage Market Settings
MANAGE_MARKET_SETTINGS.description: Can manage market settings, currencies, legal texts, payment providers and their keys, shipping setup, webhooks and the health page.

VIEW_MARKET_STATS.title: View Market Stats
VIEW_MARKET_STATS.description: Can view the market statistics page.

order-received.subject: We received your order {orderNumber}
order-received.heading: We received your order
order-received.body: Thank you for your order {orderNumber} at {storeName}. We are confirming your payment and will e-mail you again as soon as it is complete.
order-received.body-2: If your payment needs a manual check by our team, this can take a little longer.

bank-transfer-instructions.subject: Payment instructions for order {orderNumber}
bank-transfer-instructions.preheader: Transfer the amount to complete your order.
bank-transfer-instructions.heading: Complete your payment
bank-transfer-instructions.body: Thank you for your order {orderNumber} at {storeName}. Please transfer the total using the details below so we can complete your order.
bank-transfer-instructions.body-2: Your order is reserved until {expiresAt}. After that it is cancelled automatically.

order-confirmation.subject: Your order {orderNumber} is confirmed
order-confirmation.preheader: Thank you for your purchase at {storeName}.
order-confirmation.heading: Order confirmed
order-confirmation.body: Thank you for your purchase! Your order {orderNumber} at {storeName} is confirmed.
order-confirmation.body-2: Digital items are delivered to the Minecraft account automatically.
order-confirmation.shipping-address: We will ship your order to: {address}

gift-received.subject: {username} sent you a gift on {websiteName}
gift-received.preheader: A gift is waiting for you.
gift-received.heading: You received a gift!
gift-received.body: {username} sent you a gift at {storeName}. It is delivered to your Minecraft account automatically.
gift-received.body-2: If something is missing, join the server and check again in a few minutes.

order-delivered.subject: Your order {orderNumber} has been delivered
order-delivered.preheader: Everything from your order has been delivered.
order-delivered.heading: Order delivered
order-delivered.body: All items of your order {orderNumber} at {storeName} have been delivered. Enjoy!

order-refunded.subject: Refund for order {orderNumber}
order-refunded.preheader: A refund for your order was processed.
order-refunded.heading: Refund processed
order-refunded.body: We refunded {amount} for your order {orderNumber} at {storeName}.
order-refunded.body-2: Depending on your bank, it can take a few days until the money shows up.
order-refunded.credit-note-attached: The credit note is attached to this e-mail as a PDF.

expiry-reminder.subject: {productName} expires on {date}
expiry-reminder.heading: Your purchase is about to expire
expiry-reminder.body: Your {productName} from {storeName} is valid until {date}. After that you lose access to it.
expiry-reminder.body-2: Renew before it expires so nothing is interrupted.

subscription-reminder.subject: {productName} renews on {date}
subscription-reminder.heading: Your subscription renews soon
subscription-reminder.body: Your subscription to {productName} at {storeName} renews on {date}. We will charge {amount} then.
subscription-reminder.body-manual: Your subscription to {productName} at {storeName} ends on {date}. Please pay {amount} before then to keep it.

subscription-payment-failed.subject: Payment failed for {productName}
subscription-payment-failed.preheader: We could not charge your payment method.
subscription-payment-failed.heading: Payment failed
subscription-payment-failed.body: We could not charge {amount} for your subscription to {productName} at {storeName}. Your access continues until {graceEndsAt}.
subscription-payment-failed.body-no-grace: We could not charge {amount} for your subscription to {productName} at {storeName}.
subscription-payment-failed.body-2: Please update your payment to keep the subscription.

subscription-cancelled.subject: {productName} will not renew
subscription-cancelled.heading: Subscription cancelled
subscription-cancelled.body: Your subscription to {productName} at {storeName} will not renew. You keep your access until {accessUntil}.
subscription-cancelled.body-no-date: Your subscription to {productName} at {storeName} will not renew. You keep your access until the end of the current period.

subscription-ended.subject: {productName} has ended
subscription-ended.heading: Subscription ended
subscription-ended.body: Your subscription to {productName} at {storeName} has ended.

reason.BUYER_CANCEL: It ended because you cancelled it.
reason.ADMIN_CANCEL: It was cancelled by the store team.
reason.PAYMENT_FAILED: It ended because the payment could not be collected.
reason.GATEWAY_ENDED: It was ended by the payment provider.
reason.COMPLETED: It reached its last billing period.
reason.REFUND: It ended because the order was refunded.
reason.CHARGEBACK: It ended because the payment was disputed.
reason.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: It ended because the payment method is no longer available.
reason.OTHER: If you did not expect this, contact the store.

shipment-shipped.subject: Your order {orderNumber} is on its way
shipment-shipped.preheader: Your parcel has been handed to the carrier.
shipment-shipped.heading: Your order is on its way
shipment-shipped.body: Good news! Your order {orderNumber} at {storeName} has been shipped.
shipment-shipped.partial-note: This parcel holds part of your order. The rest follows in another shipment.

shipment-delivered.subject: Your order {orderNumber} was delivered
shipment-delivered.heading: Your parcel was delivered
shipment-delivered.body: The parcel of your order {orderNumber} at {storeName} was delivered.

test.subject: Test e-mail from {storeName}
test.heading: It works
test.body: This is a test e-mail from {storeName} on {websiteName}. If you can read it, the e-mail settings of your website are working.
test.footer: You are receiving this e-mail because an administrator of {websiteName} sent a test.
